# WebCodex v0.5.9

## English

This all-platform release includes the merged PR #18 and PR #19 repairs for file import, saved Desktop startup configuration, SSH waiting and diagnostics across the supported Linux, macOS and Windows distribution.

### Repairs and compatibility

- Mount each previously unvisited Settings category only on its first visit. Previously visited categories remain mounted, preserving drafts, pending operations and identity boundaries.
- Release the adapter preparation lock explicitly when preparation ends, even if a duplicated or inherited file descriptor remains open. Real lock contention and modified-resource refusal remain enforced. The deterministic duplicate-descriptor regression, focused Linux tests and native CI validation passed for the lock repair. Release-branch push CI run 42718386992 also passed on source b079; the final selected source must still pass its own exact-source gates.
- Accept the cached ChatGPT tool-import alias at the direct MCP boundary, while retaining the existing provenance, trust and permission checks. Alias compatibility does not authorize an otherwise rejected transfer.
- Backfill missing file-import defaults when Desktop restarts a saved Server configuration. This migration is cross-platform, preserves explicit `false` choices, and retains existing credentials and profile settings.
- Avoid creating selectionMotion visual mirrors for zero-size hidden items, and rebuild those mirrors when the items become visible. Observation, selection and cleanup semantics remain intact.
- Make SSH waiting follow the effective timeout rather than an inconsistent requested wait.
- Provide bounded resource and activity diagnostics. Evidence that an operation did not execute is reported only where the relevant gate proves nonexecution; diagnostics do not turn an uncertain effect into permission to retry.

Earlier Windows installer payload-consistency and bounded error-diagnostic fixes are retained. Installation ownership, private-state preservation, program hashes and execution authority checks remain enforced. Upgrade using the installer matching your operating system and architecture; existing installation and Environment state must be preserved. The earlier Windows-only v0.5.8 release and its published bytes remain unchanged.

### Candidate validation

The selectionMotion deterministic regression suite failed 3 of 22 checks against the original implementation and passed all 22 against the candidate. The full Desktop (837), runtime (424), admin (107) and docx (23) suites, plus generation checks, passed. Native Intel A/B run 42719151171 passed all 837 Desktop tests in each of its three groups, including the candidate. Because all three groups passed, this does not establish that the optimization caused every earlier timeout to disappear. Final exact-source CI and release evidence are still required.

The two new Settings retention regressions failed against the previous logic. The candidate passed the complete 839-test Desktop suite, native Intel validation of all 839 tests and the 98-test retention suite. In native A/B/A run 42728398443, both baseline groups passed all 837 tests, so these results do not establish that the changes causally eliminate every Intel timeout. Final exact-source release qualification remains required.

### Known validation limit

Live ChatGPT Host-to-real-Runner file transfer has **not yet been verified**. Source-level regression tests cover the repaired contracts but do not prove that real end-to-end transfer succeeds. The formal release gates below do not substitute for that missing live-host verification. Browser diagnostic run 42721404006 (job 129515987176), pinned to PR #24 commit c9e2899c4ee7b7f9a21d50727756b29c5eb64b3d, passed all 14 real-geometry checks in Chromium on Linux with no page errors and a clean tracked source tree. This covers the exact shared module and production CSS in synthetic DOM fixtures with real layout; it does not verify native WebView or backend integration.

### Validation and publication requirements

Final source `48f9b5ed9d7769f2c0d5013ac9fe5da501d626fe` passed exact-source push CI [42731428931](https://github.com/9holy/webcodex/actions/runs/42731428931) and release-source evidence [42731428947](https://github.com/9holy/webcodex/actions/runs/42731428947), both attempt 1. The source tree is `03ceb24f7298ad0218fa88d3bbc652d8b8225c57`. Tagged artifacts and public installer acceptance remain separate gates.

Exact-source CI and release-source evidence, the tagged six-platform formal build, persistent native macOS signing, and frozen public prerelease-byte verification are required. Windows x64 and ARM64 must each pass five real full-installer scenarios: fresh installation, unconfigured and configured upgrades from upstream v0.5.0, and unconfigured and configured upgrades from fork v0.5.4. Configured upgrades verify the running old Runtime, candidate source and four-program hashes, preserved state, service restart and cleanup.

Only after both same-attempt native reports pass may the same Release become stable/latest. Server image verification and the Intel macOS Desktop DMG/checksum pair are also required before completion. Publication is GitHub-only; no npm package is published. These are acceptance requirements, not claims that pending checks have passed. No new breaking installation-format change is intended; native acceptance remains the gate for compatibility.

## 中文

本次全平台版本包含已合并的 PR #18 与 PR #19 修复，涉及文件导入、Desktop 已保存启动配置、SSH 等待与诊断，纳入所支持的 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 发行版。

### 修复与兼容性

- Settings 中尚未访问的分类仅在首次访问时挂载；已访问分类继续保留挂载状态，保持草稿、待完成操作及身份边界。
- 适配器准备结束时显式释放准备锁，即使复制或继承的文件描述符仍保持打开。真实锁竞争与资源已修改时的拒绝机制继续保留。锁修复的确定性重复描述符回归、定向 Linux 测试与原生 CI 验证均已通过；源码 b079 的发布分支 push CI 42718386992 也已通过。最终选定源码仍须通过自身的精确源码关卡。
- 在直接 MCP 边界接受 ChatGPT 缓存的工具导入别名，同时保留现有来源证明、信任与权限检查。别名兼容不为原本应拒绝的传输授予权限。
- Desktop 重启已保存的 Server 配置时，补齐缺失的文件导入默认值。此迁移适用于跨平台，保留显式 `false` 选择、现有凭据和配置档设置。
- selectionMotion 不再为零尺寸隐藏项创建视觉镜像，并在项目变为可见时重建镜像，保留观察、选择与清理语义。
- SSH 等待遵循实际生效的超时，而不是与之不一致的请求等待值。
- 提供有界的资源与活动诊断。仅当对应检查关卡能够证明未执行时，才报告未执行证据；诊断不会将不确定的执行结果转化为重试权限。

此前 Windows 安装包载荷一致性与有界错误诊断修复继续保留。安装归属、私有状态保留、程序摘要和执行权限校验继续严格执行。请按操作系统和架构选择安装包升级，现有安装目录与 Environment 状态必须保留。此前仅 Windows 的 v0.5.8 及其已发布字节保持不变。

### 候选验证

selectionMotion 确定性回归套件在原实现上 22 项中有 3 项失败，候选实现 22 项全部通过。完整 Desktop（837 项）、runtime（424 项）、admin（107 项）和 docx（23 项）套件及生成检查均已通过。原生 Intel A/B 运行 42719151171 的三组（包括候选组）均通过全部 837 项 Desktop 测试；由于三组全部通过，不能据此因果证明此优化消除了此前所有超时。最终精确源码 CI 与发布证据仍须通过。

新增的两项 Settings 保留状态回归在旧逻辑下失败；候选通过完整 Desktop 839 项、原生 Intel 839 项及 retention 98 项验证。原生 A/B/A 运行 42728398443 的前后 baseline 均通过 837 项，因此不能据此因果宣称这些变更消除了全部 Intel 超时。最终精确源码发布验收仍须完成。

### 已知验证限制

**尚未验证真实 ChatGPT Host 到真实 Runner 的文件传输。** 源码级回归测试覆盖修复后的契约，但不能证明真实端到端传输成功。下述正式发布关卡不能替代尚缺失的真实 Host 验证。浏览器诊断运行 42721404006（job 129515987176）固定于 PR #24 提交 c9e2899c4ee7b7f9a21d50727756b29c5eb64b3d，已在 Linux Chromium 中通过全部 14 项真实几何检查，无页面错误，受跟踪源码保持清洁。范围是精确共享模块与生产 CSS 在合成 DOM 场景中的真实布局，不代表原生 WebView 或 backend 集成验证。

### 验收与发布要求

最终源码 `48f9b5ed9d7769f2c0d5013ac9fe5da501d626fe` 已通过精确源码 push CI [42731428931](https://github.com/9holy/webcodex/actions/runs/42731428931) 与发布分支证据 [42731428947](https://github.com/9holy/webcodex/actions/runs/42731428947)，均为第 1 次尝试；源码树为 `03ceb24f7298ad0218fa88d3bbc652d8b8225c57`。标签产物与公开安装验收仍是独立关卡。

必须通过精确源码 CI、发布分支证据、固定标签的六平台正式构建、持久 macOS 原生签名及公开预发布字节校验。Windows x64 与 ARM64 各需通过五项真实完整安装场景：全新安装、从上游 v0.5.0 未配置及已配置安装升级、从本分支 v0.5.4 未配置及已配置安装升级。已配置升级核对旧 Runtime 的实际运行、候选源码及四程序摘要、状态保留、服务重启与清理。

仅在同次尝试的两份原生报告全部通过后，才能将同一 Release 推广为 stable/latest；完成发布还要求 Server 镜像验证和 Intel macOS Desktop DMG/校验文件对齐。本次仅通过 GitHub 发布，不发布 npm 包。以上描述验收要求，不表示尚待运行的检查已经通过。不计划引入新的不兼容安装格式变更，兼容性仍以原生验收为准。
